facts.claim: The review deck's ask is open and waits on us.
The file has been quiet longer than any gap it closed before.
The engine filed the file's situation as an investor relationship and recorded it as unsupported, a misfiled kind, though it still shows as active.

inferences.claim: Whether the sheet went into the cohort folder is not in the file: uploads do not show in the mail, so the open ask says nothing either way.
The programme's quiet since its last mail is no sign of trouble: what the file holds now is the programme's own dates, which do not move.
The deck's date is days away, and the presentations follow soon after it.
